fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 2% of monthly Gross Sales for first 12 months, 3% for months 13-24, 4% after 24 months. No minimum monthly royalty floor disclosed. Technology Fee is $800–$1,000/month (mid-point $900 used); may increase up to 10% annually. POS leasing estimated at $295/month plus tax. Grooming Scheduling Software at $135/month ($1,620/year) plus per-message fees (~$0.01/segment). 3rd Party Courier fees $100–$250/month (variable). Advertising: months 1–12 fixed at $3,350/month LMS + $1,000/month NAF ($4,350 total/month); after month 12, lesser of 3.5% of Gross Sales or $8,333/month cap (2/3 to LMS, 1/3 to NAF), with annual cap of $100,000 total (LMS + NAF). marketing_fee_pct reflects the post-12-month rate of 3.5%; marketing_min_monthly reflects the NAF-only fixed contribution during first 12 months ($1,000). Late fee: lesser of 1.5%/month or maximum permissible rate. Audit surcharge: 25% of royalty on unreported Gross Sales if understatement ≥2%. Renewal Fee $2,500; Transfer Fee $5,000; Additional Training $300/day.
